title: Melbourne Harbor Marina
includes: All Utilities, Cable & Phone Service Available
Clean, Private Rest Rooms and Showers
blurb: Melbourne Harbor Marina is located on the Intracoastal Waterway and Indian River Lagoon, providing docking for vessels up to 130 feet. The marina offers modern concrete berths, fuel services, utilities, and amenities including restrooms, showers, laundry, and on-site restaurants. It is open to the public and located near historic downtown Melbourne with shopping, dining, and entertainment.
extraNote: Docking by reservation only, please no docking after marina closes · A $50.00 Afterhour fee will be added to your dockage
